description: Source code for the ENC28J60 Ethernet controller driver using SPI interface in Zephyr RTOS. Implements initialization, register access, packet transmission, reception, and interrupt handling.

methods.name: eth_enc28j60_soft_reset
methods.description: Performs a soft reset of the ENC28J60 device via SPI command.

methods.name: eth_enc28j60_set_bank
methods.description: Sets the register bank in ENC28J60 by writing to control registers.

methods.name: eth_enc28j60_write_reg
methods.description: Writes a byte to a specified register in ENC28J60.

methods.name: eth_enc28j60_read_reg
methods.description: Reads a byte from a specified register in ENC28J60.

methods.name: eth_enc28j60_set_eth_reg
methods.description: Sets bits in an Ethernet control register.

methods.name: eth_enc28j60_clear_eth_reg
methods.description: Clears bits in an Ethernet control register.

methods.name: eth_enc28j60_write_mem
methods.description: Writes data to ENC28J60 memory via SPI.

methods.name: eth_enc28j60_read_mem
methods.description: Reads data from ENC28J60 memory via SPI.

methods.name: eth_enc28j60_write_phy
methods.description: Writes to PHY registers of ENC28J60.

methods.name: eth_enc28j60_read_phy
methods.description: Reads from PHY registers of ENC28J60.

methods.name: eth_enc28j60_gpio_callback
methods.description: GPIO interrupt callback for ENC28J60.

methods.name: eth_enc28j60_init_buffers
methods.description: Initializes receive and transmit buffers in ENC28J60.

methods.name: eth_enc28j60_init_mac
methods.description: Initializes MAC settings including MAC address.

methods.name: eth_enc28j60_init_phy
methods.description: Initializes PHY settings for full/half duplex.

methods.name: get_iface
methods.description: Retrieves network interface, considering VLAN tagging.

methods.name: eth_enc28j60_tx
methods.description: Transmits a network packet via ENC28J60.

methods.name: enc28j60_read_packet
methods.description: Reads a received packet from ENC28J60 buffer and passes to network stack.

methods.name: eth_enc28j60_rx
methods.description: Receives packets from ENC28J60 buffer, handles buffer management.

methods.name: eth_enc28j60_rx_thread
methods.description: Dedicated thread for handling ENC28J60 interrupts and packet processing.

methods.name: eth_enc28j60_get_capabilities
methods.description: Returns hardware capabilities, e.g., 10BASE-T, VLAN support.

methods.name: eth_enc28j60_iface_init
methods.description: Initializes network interface, sets MAC address, VLAN, and carrier state.

methods.name: eth_enc28j60_init
methods.description: Device initialization: SPI, GPIO, reset, buffer, MAC, PHY, interrupts, and thread.
